definitions.onset_only: mir_eval.transcription.precision_recall_f1_overlap(ref_intervals, ref_pitches_hz, est_intervals, est_pitches_hz, onset_tolerance=0.05, pitch_tolerance=50.0, offset_ratio=None). A truth note and an estimated note match when their onsets differ by at most 0.05 s and their pitches by at most 50 cents; offsets are ignored. Each note matches at most one other (maximum bipartite matching). precision = n_matched/n_est, recall = n_matched/n_truth, f1 = 2PR/(P+R). avg_overlap_ratio: mean over matched pairs of (overlap of the two intervals)/(union of the two intervals)
definitions.onset_offset: same call with offset_ratio=0.2, offset_min_tolerance=0.05 (mir_eval defaults): in addition the estimated offset must lie within max(0.2 x truth note duration, 0.05 s) of the truth offset
definitions.onset_timing_of_matched: onset-only matched pairs; over the matched pairs above: estimated time minus truth time, in seconds (median, mean, mean of the absolute value, 95th percentile of the absolute value, largest absolute value); positive = the estimate is late
definitions.recall_by_voice: for each truth voice: matched truth notes of that voice / truth notes of that voice, using the matchings above (estimated notes carry no voice, so there is no precision per voice)
definitions.pitch: truth pitch = the truth note's MIDI number converted to Hz (440 * 2^((m-69)/12)); estimated pitches likewise

processing: MIDI: notes of every non-drum instrument were pooled; pitch is the MIDI note number; pitch bends are ignored
estimate pitch unit: midi (MIDI file note numbers)
